name: Pain & Suffering
caption: A Danger Zone Alliance tag team who dethrone New Jack and John Kronus for the PCCW World Tag Team Championship at CaliQuake '97 and retain it at Jersey Jams.
notes: Billed as part of the wider Danger Zone Alliance stable, not separately minted this pass.

name: JUSTICE
caption: A heel stable led by the Aerial Marauder whose 'Law & Order' pairing and the Machine hold the PCCW World Six-Man Tag Team Championship throughout the surviving record.

identity.note: The same billing exists in other wings; this entity was minted from its own federation's 1997 documents with no receipt joining it to those — held distinct under the no-auto-merge-and-no-silent-distinctness rule; reopenable on a shared-handler or cross-fed receipt.

name: fWo (Face World Order)
caption: An nWo-parody stable whose segments are framed as paid advertisements; its confirmed member Paul-Dog wins the PCCW World Television Championship from Ajax Shiva on 7 December 1997 with the Aerial Marauder's interference.
notes: An unnamed wider group appears at ringside to support Paul-Dog after his title win; only Paul-Dog is named on-air as a Face World Order member in the served corpus, so no other individual is minted to this unit.
